summary: The gyomu-ai-compiler package provides a collection of AI compilation pipelines focused on automating developer documentation tasks, including docstring generation, README creation, document translation, and architectural concept compilation. It structures these workflows into modular components comprising schemas, context models, renderers, and execution logic.
responsibilities: Provide pipeline execution logic and prompt rendering for AI-driven code documentation and compilation tasks.
Define structured data schemas, actions, and context models for documentation and translation workflows.
Manage execution state, retries, and validation handling during content generation processes.

capabilities.name: Docstring Update Generation
capabilities.description: Builds deterministic AI plans, actions, and schemas for automatically updating function, method, and class docstrings.

capabilities.name: LLM Context Rendering
capabilities.description: Renders and formats conversation messages and prompts for generating LLM context across various document sections.

capabilities.name: README Documentation Generation
capabilities.description: Constructs prompts, user data structures, and message flows for automatically generating project README documentation.

capabilities.name: Document Translation Execution
capabilities.description: Executes document translation pipelines with built-in validation handling, retry support, and state management.

capabilities.name: Package and Directory Compilation
capabilities.description: Analyzes and compiles high-level package and directory architectural concepts from source code inputs.

design_decisions: Organizes functionality into discrete, task-oriented pipelines (e.g., docstring updates, README generation, translation, LLM context).
Separates core schema definitions, execution logic, and rendering mechanisms within each pipeline.
Leverages external AI, infrastructure, and schema support libraries for underlying execution and data modeling.
usage_guidance: Use the specific pipeline modules (such as docstring_update, readme, or translation) to execute automated documentation and compilation workflows.
Leverage the rendering components to construct LLM conversation messages and prompts tailored to particular document sections.
Utilize schema and context definitions to model inputs and structured AI update actions safely.
